title: ConsistencyAI: A Benchmark to Assess LLMs’ Factual Consistency When Responding to Different Demographic Groups
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring the factual consistency of LLM responses across different demographic personas using cosine similarity of sentence embeddings. While it evaluates consistency on topics with ethical or moral dimensions (such as abortion and the death penalty), its primary goal is to assess data stability and ideological neutrality rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
